statement: An isosceles triangle \(ABC\) with \(AB = AC\) is given. A variable circle \((O)\) with center on line \(BC\) passes through \(A\) and does not touch lines \(AB\) or \(AC\). Let \(M\) and \(N\) be the second intersections of \((O)\) with lines \(AB\) and \(AC\). Find the locus of the orthocenter of triangle \(AMN\).

Given positive integers \(m < 2001\) and \(n < 2002\). Distinct real numbers are written in the cells of a \(2001 \times 2002\) board. A cell is called \emph{bad} if its number is smaller than at least \(m\) numbers in the same column and at least \(n\) numbers in the same row. Let \(s\) be the total number of bad cells. Find the least possible value of \(s\).

Let \(a, b, c\) be real numbers for which \(x^3 + ax^2 + bx + c\) has three real roots. Prove that
\[12ab + 27c \leq 6a^3 + 10(a^2 - 2b)^{3/2}.\]
When does equality occur?
Determine all positive integers \(n\) for which the equation \(a + b + c + d = n\sqrt{abcd}\) has positive integer solutions.

For a positive integer \(n\), consider the equation
\[\frac{1}{x-1} + \frac{1}{4x-1} + \cdots + \frac{1}{k^2x-1} + \cdots + \frac{1}{n^2x-1} = \frac{1}{2}.\]
a) Prove that for every \(n\), this equation has a unique root \(x_n > 1\).\\
b) Prove that \(\lim_{n \to \infty} x_n = 4\).
